Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Gorgui Dieng?

Gorgui Dieng is 36 years old.

Where was Gorgui Dieng born?

Gorgui Dieng was born in Kebemer, Senegal.

When was Gorgui Dieng born?

Gorgui Dieng was born on January 18, 1990.

How tall is Gorgui Dieng?

Gorgui Dieng is 6-10 (208 cm) tall.

How much did Gorgui Dieng weigh when playing?

Gorgui Dieng weighed 252 lbs (114 kg) when playing.

Is Gorgui Dieng in the Hall of Fame?

Gorgui Dieng is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Gorgui Dieng drafted?

Gorgui Dieng was drafted by Utah Jazz, 1st round (21st pick, 21st overall), 2013 NBA Draft.

What position did Gorgui Dieng play?

Center and Power Forward.

When did Gorgui Dieng retire?

Gorgui Dieng last played in 2023.

What is Gorgui Dieng's net worth?

Gorgui Dieng made at least $76,359,107 playing professional basketball.

How much did Gorgui Dieng make?

Gorgui Dieng made $16,587,688 in 2021.

What did Gorgui Dieng average?

Gorgui Dieng averaged 7.3 points, 5.6 rebounds, and 1.3 assists per game.

How many rings does Gorgui Dieng have?

Gorgui Dieng won 0 championships.

What is Gorgui Dieng's Instagram account?

Gorgui Dieng is on Instagram at gorguidieng.

What schools did Gorgui Dieng attend?

Gorgui Dieng attended Huntington Prep in Huntington, West Virginia and Louisville.

What are Gorgui Dieng's nicknames?

Senegalese Sniper, Trebuchet are nicknames for Gorgui Dieng.
